This '''carbon-freezing chamber''' was in a tower hangar of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==History==
[[File:CarbonFreezeControls-TC.png|thumb|left|200px|Erk Zallis at the controls]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi Temple of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had a carbon freezing chamber in one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] a male [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] technician, [[Erk Zallis/Legends|Erk Zallis]] was working at this chamber.<ref name="CC">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_erkzallis.jpg|text=Clone Card: Erk Zallis|nobackup=1}}</ref> Before the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission to the Citadel]], an infamous [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist's]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were carbon freezed to infiltrate safely into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]. Because [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]], a warden of the Citadel, and his [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[K2-B4/Legends|K2-B4]] scanned every [[Starship/Legends|ship]] toward the prison for lifeforms, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] elite team had to avoid the scan by being frozen.<ref name="TC" />
